source: sqlite3 -readonly data/api/envoy.db (the live :8700 API), read Nov 4, 2026; the cross_post task Muse started in the Nov 4 take, and its three parts
what: One cross_post call from Muse in the Nov 4 take, for a Reel, a Short and a TikTok. Envoy ran it as one task with a part per destination, one after another, and every part ended done.
notes: Before the call, at 12:55:46, the clip envoy-reel-purple.mp4 went to Envoy's phone through send_to_phone (handoff-1104-125546-e88f, origin mcp, status sent); the person accepted its offer on the iPhone at 12:55:51. That row records the MCP origin, not the agent's name.
task-1104-125621-f88d is the cross_post task (kind crossapp, no parent). The other three are its parts (kind routine, parent = that id).
model_calls are Envoy's own. The cross_post task's 3 calls and $0.0071 are the TikTok part's: its routine reads TikTok's drawn sound list with vision.

seconds runs from a row's created time to its updated time, so it includes any wait on the person. Each routine's data/routines/<name>/index.json lists its part as <id>-r1, with the routine's own duration_s.
